caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chair rendered in grayscale tones, suggesting it is either a pencil or charcoal illustration on a light, off-white background. The chair has an upright back with a decorative central splat that is vase-shaped, and the top rail of the backrest curves outward at the ends and features two visible round fasteners. The seat is rectangular with slightly rounded edges, and the front legs are straight while the back legs are slightly curved, following the contour of the backrest. There are two horizontal stretchers connecting the legs on the sides and a central stretcher connecting the front and back legs. The shadows and highlights are used to give the chair a sense of three-dimensionality and depth. No other objects or background elements are present, keeping the composition simple and focused on the chair itself.
title: Dining Room Suite
